question: Is the roughly 0.11 KLD observed in the P8 forced-decode endpoint also present for stock NVFP4 and production EXL3 under the identical forced-token/logit-capture path?
capture_patch: The exact sampler, warmup, and p8_decode_capture package bytes used by p8-index-order-full-v1 are applied independently to each pinned parent image.
window_selection: One per domain, deterministically chosen from already-opened P8 full32 results as the lexicographically smallest four-window combination whose P8 equal-window all-row mean is closest to the frozen P8 full32 mean. This is a targeted diagnostic, not held-out inference.
metric: KL(teacher || student), nats, FP64 CPU, all 154880 vocabulary entries; report all-row and true-decode-only means separately

decision_before_result.codec_exonerated_for_the_0_11_endpoint: Both stock and EXL3 selected4 all-row means fall in [0.09,0.15].
decision_before_result.production_serving_bug_supported: Exoneration rule passes and neither control improves at least 20 percent relative to the paired P8 selected4 mean.
decision_before_result.otherwise: Do not attribute the P8 endpoint to a shared serving bug; preserve arm-specific results.

retry_policy: No silent retry or substitution. Preserve a failed arm and amend explicitly.
claim_boundary: Four deliberately representative windows diagnose the serving path; they do not replace the frozen full32 quality estimate.
